inputs.label: Wing Commander (DOS, GOG)
inputs.help: Your GOG Wing Commander folder: the one that holds WC.EXE, SM2.EXE and GAMEDAT.

steps.why: The game reads /sdcard/WingCommander. The guide has the user allow access to all files on the first start.

steps.text: Open Wing Commander VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to all files, allow it.

notes: The GOG install folder name is not stated in the guide, so stores has no installDir. The release also carries WingCommanderVR-1.0.1.zip and a .sha256 file, which the asset pattern does not match. The tag prefix is quest-vr-.
